## **Welcome to Eon**

If you are reading this, you are probably tired of the noise. Crypto trading usually involves staring at complex charts, reading panic-inducing tweets, and hunting through whitepapers - all at the same time. **It’s exhausting.**

**We built Eon to fix that.** Eon isn't just another trading terminal with more flashing lights. It is a filter. It takes the mountain of data generated by the crypto market every second and turns it into simple, actionable answers.

Think of it as having a team of senior analysts sitting next to you, 24/7, ready to answer any question you have.

![](</img/1 (1).png>)

**Quick Start: The 30-Second Tour**

Eon is designed to be intuitive, but here is the lay of the land to get you oriented quickly:

**Home Page:** This is your starting point. It features Eon’s homepage, where you can chat directly with our AI agents. Just ask questions in plain English (e.g., "Why is SOL pumping today?").

**The Explore Menu:** Located on the left sidebar, this is your deep-dive toolkit. It contains dedicated scanners for Market Overview, Whale Tracking, Technical Analysis, Fundamentals, Token Unlocks, and News.

**The Sidebar (Right):** Your persistent HUD. It keeps your Watchlist, Market Tracker, and vital Market Summary visible no matter where you are in the app.

**System Requirements**

Eon is a web-based platform, meaning you don't need to download any heavy software. It lives in the cloud.

**Supported Browsers:** We recommend using the latest versions of **Google Chrome**, **Brave**, **Safari**, or **Microsoft Edge** for the best experience.

**Mobile Access:** Eon is fully responsive. You can access it from your smartphone or tablet via your mobile browser.

**Wallet Connection:** To unlock the full features, you will need a Web3 wallet (like MetaMask, Rabbit, or Phantom) and an email address,

Ready to get started? Let’s get you logged in.
